offices.title: Member of Congress (US House)
offices.desc: Passes national legislation, overrides vetoes, and manages federal budget line-items.

offices.title: US Senator
offices.desc: Represents the state at the federal legislature tier structure.

offices.title: State Senate (Upper Chamber)
offices.desc: Presides over statewide legislation, confirms appointments, and audits governor bills.

offices.title: State Assembly Member (Lower Chamber)
offices.desc: Drafts regional legislation, introduces budget codes, and sits as the direct voice of your house district.

offices.title: School Board Member
offices.run_note: Excellent entry-level position for citizens looking to get involved in local public governance.
offices.desc: Oversees school district policies, budgets, and curriculum frameworks.

offices.title: County Sheriff
offices.run_note: A powerful local role that often sets law enforcement priorities for the whole county.
offices.desc: Manages local jails, sets arrest priorities, and guides county law enforcement.

offices.title: District Attorney / Prosecutor
offices.run_note: Requires a valid legal background and active state bar membership.
offices.desc: Wields broad discretion over charges, bail terms, and sentencing recommendations.

offices.title: County Coroner
offices.run_note: Varies by county; some jurisdictions require medical degree licenses while others do not.
offices.desc: Oversees localized forensic death investigations and autopsy audits.

offices.title: Local Trial Court Judge
offices.run_note: Presides over local civil, criminal, family, or landlord-tenant case dockets.
offices.desc: Presides over civil, criminal, family, or landlord-tenant case dockets.

offices.title: City Council Member
offices.run_note: Great position for local community organizers and grassroots neighborhood activists.
offices.desc: Approves municipal budgets, passes local ordinances, and regulates zoning laws.

offices.title: Mayor (Executive)
offices.run_note: Acts as the executive leader of the city administration. Manages municipal departments.
offices.desc: Appoints department heads (police, sanitation) and manages daily city operations.

offices.title: County Board Supervisor / Commissioner
offices.run_note: Manages county property assets, public road maintenance funds, and overall budget allocations.
offices.desc: Levies county taxes, issues service contracts, and administers elections.

offices.title: Public Works / Water Commissioner
offices.run_note: Focuses heavily on regional resource distribution and civil public utilities.
offices.desc: Manages utility rates, water supply, sewage, and public environmental infrastructure.

offices.title: City Comptroller
offices.run_note: Acts as the financial watchdog for city agency budgets and contract allocations.
offices.desc: Chief financial officer auditing local agencies, contracts, and municipal pensions.

offices.title: State Senator (Unicameral)
offices.desc: Serves in the nation's only single-chamber nonpartisan state legislature.

offices.title: County Commissioner
offices.desc: Levies county property taxes and administers local precinct operations.

offices.title: County Judge
offices.run_note: A powerful executive role in Texas. Despite the name, a law degree is not required.
offices.desc: Presides over the County Commissioners Court and manages disaster declarations.

offices.title: Parish President
offices.desc: Serves as the chief executive head of Louisiana's parish operational grids.
